look: 9 meter Stegosaurus, two rows of large upright kite-shaped back plates, tiny head, arched back higher at the hips, four spikes on the tail, four legs, green-brown hide with orange-edged plates,
texture_prompt: green-brown pebbled hide, orange and cream edged back plates, pale belly, matte surface

clips.attack_primary: Plated dinosaur swings its spiked tail
clips.attack_heavy: Plated dinosaur turns its rear, holds, then sweeps its spiked tail through
clips.knockdown: Plated dinosaur collapses onto its side
clips.alert: Plated dinosaur raises its head and stiffens its plates

head_look._note: HEADLOOK: # ASSUMPTION clamp (small low head on a stiff neck); default 60/30. {"enabled": false} opts out, "off_clips" adds clips the look fades out on (scripts/creatures/head_look.gd)

pipeline.mesh: Tripo H3.1 mesh (orchestrator session), rotated to face -Z, scaled to 6.4 m, seams welded; textures 2048
pipeline.rig_and_animation: Opus builder in Blender: 34 bones incl. jaw and 7 tail bones, IK feet, heat weights with rigid plates/spikes
pipeline.recolour: gentle global hue grade of Tripo's original colour map (work/tripo_grade.py), no masks
pipeline.variant_note: Two looks on one Tripo mesh, rig and clip set (bakeoff/stegosaurus-v2): graded = the shipped grey-brown grade (GLB as authored), ochre = the earlier olive hide with amber-edged plates (work/tripo_stegosaurus_ochre.glb albedo). The museum recolour was rejected by the owner and is not used.
pipeline.grounding: 2026-10-30 STEGOFIX: charge, kick, death, knockdown, strafe_left/right sank 2-7 cm; tools/gait/ground_clip.py lifts the root on those frames. Gate: Blender -b -P tools/gait/check_stego.py -- stegosaurus.glb anim (STEGO_CHECK PASS)
pipeline.verifier: creature-verify.mjs --height 6.4: ALL HARD CHECKS PASSED (feed, sleep, tail_swipe optional, missing)

weights.method: continuous anatomical spine and single-limb weights, max four

authored_clips.knockdown: 90-degree side collapse ending with grounded hold
